about: localrouter's model cache (volter-ai/localrouter 107fb5d cache/node.mjs:633), which reads the Hub with fetch and no token (the descriptor's clientCasesNone): a publisher on the World-issued HF_TOKEN creates a model repository through the API, pushes its history to git-receive-pack and its LFS object through the batch API, as twin-world's cookbook/localrouter/seed.mjs does; the cache then downloads each artifact at the pinned commit with redirects followed, resumes a partial file with Range and If-Range, adopts a complete one on 416 and checks the pinned sha256. Readback after resume downloads and verifies the same pinned artifacts without writing. The publisher builds its pack with the local git.
